errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the label for the first slice. The image shows the label is “Level1 - 8.2”, not “Level - 8.2”.

The description states all slices are 'colored blue', which is an over-generalization. The chart uses three distinct shades of blue (light blue, medium blue, and dark blue) to differentiate the slices, and this detail is lost.

errors.text_span: The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of area.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The slice sizes are 44.32%, 30.04%, and 25.64%. The visual arrangement of the slices (clockwise: 30.04%, 25.64%, 44.32%) is not ordered from largest to smallest.
